derivation.method: Selected B03 alpha plus its central lapel opening. Transparent arm/torso background gaps stay transparent. The renderer derives this mask from the selected jacket, without an outer-envelope fill.
derivation.neck_gap_finding: The pale-looking strip is exposed transparency where old shirt support ended before the B03 translucent inner edge. Keep source shirt fabric behind that edge; do not erase the edge.
derivation.source_cuffs: Continuous photographic cuff surfaces render below the selected jacket and above trousers; original hands render last.
derivation.cuff_ownership: Native selected-jacket sleeve-end curve with 2–3 pixel underlap, tapering into the fixed original hand wrist cap. Only existing photographic cuff pixels survive the intersection.

neckline.method: Manual native-coordinate trace of the dark navy cloth / repeated gray ribbed-strip boundary in the exact B02 source. Clip alpha only; preserve source RGB and all other jackets.
neckline.purpose: Remove baked foreign gray strip from the left neckline before the continuous shirt is composited.
neckline.scope: Targeted continuous-shirt candidate only; no source raster mutation.
neckline.top_cap_correction: The prior clip left the constant RGB (21,22,27) top cap of the same ribbed extension. Native v7 shows it as a spur on bare neck. Clip its right-side extension to the real navy cloth boundary; no textured lapel pixels left of x389.5 are removed.
